title: Zimbabwe Lion:
title_q: “They All Play Different Roles in My Life”
title_short: Zimbabwe Lion · Different Roles in My Life
headline: A young Leo Lion from Zimbabwe says everyone in her club is family, because each one plays a different role in her life.
story: A young Leo Lion from Zimbabwe is asked if anyone in her club is like family. “Basically everyone.” If she needs one kind of advice she goes to one person, for another kind she goes to someone else. They all play different roles in her life, so they are all family.

Then her own path: she moved from Leo to Leo Lion to keep serving and growing, and one day she will be a Lion. The last quarter is her invitation: be at the next convention, it is a blast, she is learning a lot and meeting people from all over. Bright, young, joyful.
